description: A React component for displaying and managing a card dialog in a board application, including features like editing, deleting, attaching files, and creating templates.

methods.name: makeTemplateClicked
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new template from the current card, tracks telemetry, and duplicates the card.

methods.name: handleDeleteCard
methods.description: Deletes the current card and tracks telemetry.

methods.name: confirmDialogProps
methods.description: Properties for the confirmation dialog box used when deleting a card.

methods.name: handleDeleteButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles the delete button click, confirming deletion if necessary.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Renders the actions menu for the card, including the option to create a template.

methods.name: removeUploadingAttachment
methods.description: Removes an uploading attachment block from the attachments list.

methods.name: selectAttachment
methods.description: Handles file selection and upload process for attachments.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new attachment element to the card.

methods.name: attachBtn
methods.description: Renders the attach button with permission gating.
